transcript: Speaker A: Society ke log mujhe guard uncle bolte the. Ab unke bacche mujhe bolte hain, 'Uncle aap toh English mein baat karte ho, corporate mein kaise lagi job?' Hotel mein gaya, bole English aani chahiye. Mall mein gaya, bole English mein baat karni padegi customers se. Corporate park mein security supervisor ki vacancy thi, salary 25000 rupaye. Aapke paas hai, use karo. Speaker A: Om Prakash ne socha, beti ka chehra yaad aaya. Download kar liya. Us raat duty pe baithe-baithe English Seekho app khola. General English show, 'Hello se baat shuru karein' pehla video. Hindi mein samjhaya tha. 'My name is Om Prakash. I work as a security guard.' Itna bola pehli baar. Doosri raat roz ke 10 easy sentences dekha. 'Good morning sir, how can I help you? Please sign the register. Your cab is waiting. May I see your ID please?' Teesri raat good manners ke English words dekha. 'Welcome sir. Have a good day. Please wait, I will check. Thank you for visiting.' Ab roz raat ki duty ka routine badal gaya. 10 se 12, English Seekho app pe video dekho. 12 se 2, AI coach se practice karo. 2 se 4, jo seekho woh gate pe aane waale logon pe try karo. 4 se 6, society ka round lagao. AI coach se roz baat karta tha. AI coach ne sikha diya. 'I have 10 years of experience in security. I can manage visitor logs, coordinate with the admin team, and handle emergency situations. I am comfortable communicating in English with residents and guests.' Ek hi practice ki. 500 baar galat bola, 500 baar sudhara. Pehle hafte gate pe aane waale delivery boy ko bola, 'Good evening, please sign here.' Delivery boy ne dekha, smile kiya. Doosre hafte society ke uncle aaye raat ko, Om Prakash ne bola, 'Good night sir, have a good sleep.' Uncle ruk gaye, bole, 'Om Prakash, tune English seekh li?' Ek mahine mein basic confidence aa gaya. Rohit ne bola, 'Uncle, ab corporate interview do.' Ek tech park mein security supervisor ki vacancy thi, salary 22000 rupaye. Interview gaya. Interviewer: Can you tell us about your experience? Speaker A: I maintain the visitor log, handle deliveries, and ensure the safety of 80 families. I am comfortable speaking in English, and I can coordinate with your admin and facility team. Interviewer ne dekha, notes liye, bola, 'When can you join?' Salary 22000 rupaye. Pehle 8000 thi, teen guna. Teen mahine mein 66000 rupaye extra aa gaye. 6 mahine mein 1,32,000 rupaye. 10 mahine mein 2 lakh rupaye se zyada bach gaya. Beti ki shaadi ki date fix hui. Society ka Rohit ab bhi milta hai kabhi-kabhi. 'Uncle, kaisa chal chal raha hai?' 'Beta, tere wajah se chal raha hai. Fark sirf ek language ka hai. Woh language seekho, zindagi badal jayegi. Speaker D: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo.

summary: The ad tells the story of Om Prakash, a 55-year-old security guard earning 8,000 rupees who needs money for his daughter's wedding. Encouraged by a college student, he utilizes his free night-shift hours to learn English using the 'English Seekho' app. He successfully lands a corporate security supervisor job paying 22,000 rupees, funds the wedding with dignity, and encourages viewers to download the app to transform their lives.
